venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 2/14.** Busy from the start; books pre-plotted and filled via the online notify list, leaving little room for walk-ins. Tock went down: MOD created a shift on Resy and moved all reservations from 7pm on, lost the waitlist and prioritized walk-ups at the Garden/bar first come first serve; reservations held strictly to times and durations (many later reservations were nightcaps after dinner). Garden slammed until ~11, closed shortly after midnight. Interesting night between Tock and some weird/bad dates. Guest count pulled from Lightspeed (at least 105 on Tock). Kitchen: 13% of sales; late orders kept the kitchen open later. MOD: Kevin / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: Pretty nice, given the past two weeks
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 2/14.** Frenetic open; Tock failed, leaving no consistent waitlist (operational, not volume, issue); Thursday-like night on a Saturday lacking massive groups. Observed anxious early dates among campers. Comps $289.15 (massive date and industry turnout; Tock issues also produced duplications). Top sellers: Year of the Trees, Material Control, Masari. Door: Valentine's Day Tock crash right at open; operated old-school, tracking names, times and tables in the Notes app and communicating constantly; stopped holding a waitlist in major hours but quoted check-back times and got people in quickly; protected 8pm reservations; stayed full to the end with large parties at 1am; Tock back around midnight; thanks to Haleigh. Repairs: Tock is permanently canceled.
